Select from base toggles transformed mode; select from transformed can return to base. Current best reading: recent states can also look like transformed T3/M3-style upper/middle specials with a lingering DR overlay, so probing right tests horizontal transformed mobility toward cluster 4.

Current ambiguity: upper c1&c2 altered persists while a special-looking 7-bordered state appears active; probe UP to distinguish left special -> lower c1 from right special -> lower c2.

Level 1 seems node-navigation. Nodes: top A1-A4 (default outline 1), middle row B1-B4 (default 9), bottom row C1 default 9 and C2 default 2. Confirmed moves: A4 right->A1. A2<->B2. Stable-looking state observed: A1+A2 transformed, A3+A4 default, with B1 altered to 3/4-style and B2 outlined 7. Best next probe: B2 right->B3, then likely select B3 to test A3 symmetry.
